Interior plate for a historical docudrama — a South African boy's small bedroom at night, 1983. On a small wooden desk: a Commodore VIC-20 home computer with its boxy beige keyboard-case, connected to a small CRT screen glowing with green-on-dark BASIC code, a cassette tape drive beside it, a desk lamp off. Stacked sci-fi paperbacks, a hand-drawn rocket sketch pinned to the wall, a narrow bed in shadow. The room lit only by the cool blue-green CRT glow. Period-accurate early-1980s detail. Vertical 9:16-friendly composition. RAW 35mm Kodak Portra 400 color, real shadow falloff, real material texture, believable physical detail everywhere.
